# Safar Trails

> Safar Trails is an Indian travel agency crafting custom holiday packages and AI-assisted itineraries across India and abroad. We combine AI speed with human travel specialist expertise, offering hand-planned itineraries, verified stays, transparent pricing, and 24x7 on-trip support.

## Core Services & Tools
- [AI Trip Planner](https://safartrails.co.in/ai-planner): Instant day-by-day custom India travel itinerary generator with realistic budget estimates.
- [Holiday Packages](https://safartrails.co.in/packages): Curated holiday packages with verified stays, private cabs, and transparent day-wise inclusions.
- [Destinations](https://safartrails.co.in/destinations): Comprehensive travel guides, best seasons, top attractions, and local travel tips.

## Key Destinations Covered
- [Kashmir Tour Packages](https://safartrails.co.in/destinations/kashmir): Srinagar, Dal Lake houseboats, Gulmarg Gondola & skiing, Pahalgam valleys, Sonamarg glaciers.
- [Kerala Tour Packages](https://safartrails.co.in/destinations/kerala): Alleppey luxury houseboats, Munnar tea estates, Thekkady wildlife, Kovalam beaches.
- [Himachal Pradesh Tours](https://safartrails.co.in/destinations/himachal-pradesh): Manali, Shimla, Rohtang Pass, Solang Valley, Dharamshala, Spiti Valley.
- [Rajasthan Heritage Tours](https://safartrails.co.in/destinations/rajasthan): Jaipur palaces, Udaipur lake resorts, Jaisalmer Thar desert camps, Jodhpur Mehrangarh fort.
- [Chardham Yatra Pilgrimage](https://safartrails.co.in/destinations/chardham-yatra): Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath sacred pilgrimage tours with VIP darshan and helicopter options.
- [Andaman Islands](https://safartrails.co.in/destinations/andaman): Port Blair, Havelock Island (Radhanagar Beach), Neil Island water sports.
- [Ladakh Expeditions](https://safartrails.co.in/destinations/ladakh): Pangong Tso, Nubra Valley, Khardung La, magnetic hill road trips.
- [Goa Vacations](https://safartrails.co.in/destinations/goa): North Goa beach nightlife and South Goa heritage resorts.

## Why Travelers Choose Safar Trails
- **AI Speed + Human Perfection:** AI designs the initial route in seconds; experienced destination specialists refine hotels, timings, and logistics.
- **Transparent Pricing:** No hidden booking fees, no surprise cab surcharges. All inclusions clearly itemized.
- **Verified Stays:** Stays personally vetted for hygiene, heating/cooling, view, and family safety.
- **24x7 On-Trip Concierge:** Dedicated WhatsApp trip manager assisting with flight delays, local permits, gondola tickets, and doctor-on-call.
